description: Logical path: starting traversal from an intermediate (non-root) node yields only the sub-tree reachable from that node, not the whole component. amd/b.js depends only on amd/c.js so its tree is {b, c}, excluding the original entry amd/a.js. Entering the cycle from cyclic/b.js still resolves the full two-file cycle since b references a which references b back.
